svg.text: One startup path. Any failure in it becomes one logged line and a non-zero exit; the process never starts half-wired.
The fixture configuration runs this identical wiring with DETECTOR_CMD pointed at a recorded JSONL stream, so the core runs whole with no model and no clip. There is no mock branch
anywhere in the core, which is what makes the fixture run evidence about the real code.
The detector's warm-up — the ONNX session load and the clip open — precedes its first emitted line. That interval is the run origin the demo choreography is aligned against, and it
is still unmeasured on the deployed node.
env: ports, gate constants, clip path
config load — the only read of the environment
bind udp :47200 and start the receive thread
spawn DETECTOR_CMD, keep the stdout pipe
